newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese manufacturing indicator stronger in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese manufacturing indicator stronger in Feb.

text.p: An indicator measuring confidence in the Portuguese manufacturing sector showed a more positive trend in February than January, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said.

"In all sub-sectors, indicators measuring production were more positive than in the previous month," INE said in a monthly report. "The segment of investment goods contributed most to the rise of the overall indicator."
It added: "In all sub-sectors the average for the last three months was superior to the average for 1996."
